verdict.rationale: TypeSafe's models documentation states that Jev is not trained on customer requests or responses, and that the model is not fine-tuned or LoRA-adapted with customer data. Customer data is therefore excluded from training by default, with no opt-out step needed, and the page points to a DPA and Privacy Policy. Missing for 10: the DPA and Privacy Policy terms themselves are not in the evidence, zero data retention is limited to enterprise customers, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of the no-training claim.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
